chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from some of our companions, from al-Khashshāb, from al-ʿAbbās ibn ʿĀmir, from Rabīʿ al-Muslī, from Yaḥyā ibn Zakariyyā al-Anṣārī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), who said:

I heard him saying: “Whoever is pleased to complete the whole of faith, then let him say: My position in all matters is the position of the Āl of Muḥammad regarding what they kept hidden and what they made public, and regarding what reached me from them and what did not reach me.”

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, whose guidance is to be followed
key_terms.أَسَرُّوا: what they kept hidden or did not disclose openly
key_terms.أَعْلَنُوا: what they made public and openly declared
key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ: faith, understood here as something perfected through complete adherence
key_terms.الْقَوْلُ: one’s stated position or declared stance
key_terms.بَلَغَنِي: what reached me or came to my knowledge

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the completion of faith through submission to the Āl of Muḥammad?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the completion of iman lies in full submission to the guidance of the Āl of Muḥammad in all matters. It expresses a creedal stance of acceptance toward their teachings, whether publicly known or not yet conveyed to the individual.
